scripts.build: if [ "$RENDER" = "true" ]; then npm run render:build; else bash scripts/build-verified.sh; fi
scripts.start: if [ "$RENDER" = "true" ]; then npm run render:start; else WRANGLER_LOG_PATH=.wrangler/wrangler.log vinext start; fi
scripts.test: npm run build && node --experimental-strip-types --test tests/comparison-case.test.ts tests/corridor-publication.test.ts tests/display-quotes.test.ts && node --test tests/wordpress-plugin.test.mjs tests/quote-table.test.mjs && node --experimental-loader ./scripts/cloudflare-node-loader.mjs --test tests/rendered-html.test.mjs && npm run test:comparison-content && npm run test:evidence
scripts.test:comparison-content: node --experimental-strip-types --test tests/corridor-comparison.test.ts && node --test tests/customer-reviews.test.mjs tests/provider-comparison.test.mjs tests/corridor-context.test.mjs
scripts.test:evidence: node --experimental-strip-types --test tests/weekly-transfer-costs.test.ts && node --test tests/weekly-transfer-render.test.mjs tests/provider-evidence-summary.test.mjs tests/public-api.test.mjs tests/api-discovery.test.mjs tests/research-citations.test.mjs
